listings.name: Yocha Dehe Ranch

Marketed under Séka Hills brand alongside olive oil, wine, and honey from the Yocha Dehe Wintun Nation.

Cattle are raised on open pastures across 20,000 acres with sustainable grazing practices that reflect generations of land stewardship. Available through Séka Hills Beef Club with quarterly pickup at the tasting room in Brooks.

listings.name: Mariposa Ranch

Confirm current inventory and pricing on shop before ordering.
listings.description: Family ranch in Idaho's Pahsimeroi Valley raising certified organic, 100% grass-fed and grass-finished Black Angus on wild mountain pastures and home-ranch forage. Ranch-direct since 2005; ships frozen organic beef nationwide (lower 48).
